note: The two sets are nearly identical, but Set A labels the disconnect as "DC NFDS", a qualifier the page never states (the note reads only "200A/2P NFDS, NEMA 3R ENCLOSURE"); Set B keeps the entity as "NFDS" and is otherwise the same. Both sets bind the wiring-schedule values correctly with matching quotes and keep material/conduit conditions. Both also repeat several facts under two names (e.g. NFDS rating, main-breaker rating, panel phase, #4G and #10G ground sizes) and both omit schedule rows 50, 33 and 10 plus the main bonding jumper and sensor circuits.
remarks: Only real differentiator is the invented "DC" qualifier in Set A's NFDS enclosure claim. Shared gaps: wiring schedule rows 50 (AL: 3#6, #8G., 1"C.), 33 (CU: 6#10, 3#10G., 1"C.) and 10 (CU: #12/2WG.), the MAIN BONDING JUMPER note, and the voltage/current sensor circuits to the organizer instrumentation panel. Text layer scrambles schedule row numbers (e.g. "31"/"32" trailing the description lines), but the image confirms the row-to-description pairing used by both sets.
